goal: Implement one small, well-tested feature in the current repo without breaking existing tests.
guardrails: Do not add dependencies unless the feature cannot be built without one.
Do not commit or push; leave changes uncommitted for review.
name: build-feature
steps: Read the repo README and the files around the feature area; summarize the current behavior in 3 lines.
Write the smallest change that implements the feature; add or update tests first if the repo has a test suite.
Run the repo's test command and the new tests; fix failures without widening scope.
Summarize the diff: files changed, tests added, and anything deliberately left out.
